Delhi High Court orders removal of AI deepfakes of Kangana Ranaut

The Delhi High Court has ordered Meta to remove artificial intelligence-generated deepfakes and other fake content impersonating actress Kangana Ranaut. The court granted Ranaut personality rights protection, directing the social media platform to take down infringing material.
